raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: lwt
  version: "6.1.3"

  build_number: 0

  library: ${{ "Library/" if not unix else "" }}
  m2: ${{ "m2-" if not unix else "" }}
  # ocaml_win-64 ships gcc_* and vs2022_* at the same version/build; name the track.
  c_toolchain: ${{ "" if unix else c_compiler ~ "_*" }}
  # static archive paired with the .cmxa: msvc ships .lib, gcc and unix ship .a
  native_lib_ext: ${{ ".lib" if c_compiler == "vs2022" else ".a" }}

recipe:
  name: ocaml-${{ name }}-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/ocsigen/lwt/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 6bc311d7e8aa6a16243ec6c77f9c60a1f17950bc754f2ea3d60e18ff31c155e2
  # vendored until ppx_devtools-optcomp is on conda-forge; lwt 6.1.3 lwt.unix needs it at build time
  - url: https://github.com/ocsigen/ppx_devtools/releases/download/0.1/ppx_devtools-0.1.tbz
    sha256: 46ad4e62a213e3c0852c02cd1cc182d88ec89afa284a45a4316cfb3ffc0bcb9c
    target_directory: vendor/ppx_devtools

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}

outputs:
  - package:
      name: ocaml-${{ name }}
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      string: ${{ c_compiler ~ "_" if not unix }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      script: bash ${{ RECIPE_DIR }}/build.sh lwt
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("ocaml") }}
        - if: not unix and c_compiler == "gcc"
          then:
            - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
          else:
            - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        # lwt_unix has C stubs: a C compiler on every lane
        - if: unix
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - if: not unix and c_compiler == "gcc"
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("m2w64_c") }}
        # ocaml_win-64 >=14 only run-constrains the C compiler; activate it here, once (vs2022, zig)
        - if: not unix and c_compiler != "gcc"
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        # compiler("ocaml") renders no toolchain track; name it on windows
        - if: not unix
          then:
            - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
        # the cross compiler does not pull the native one; the build runs OCaml on the build machine
        - if: build_platform != target_platform and unix
          then:
            - ocaml_${{ build_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
            # the cross compiler activates itself (shims, OCAMLLIB, host OCAMLPATH)
            - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
        # windows cross: the self-contained gcc track needs no vcvars
        - if: build_platform != target_platform and not unix
          then:
            - ocaml_${{ build_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* gcc_*
        - ocaml-dune >=3.20
        - ocaml-cppo >=1.1
        - ${{ m2 }}make
        - if: not unix
          then:
            - m2-bash
            - m2-coreutils
      host:
        # library: ocaml's run_export pins the compiler patch version
        - ocaml ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
        # the noarch ocaml metapackage does not pin the windows toolchain track
        - if: not unix
          then:
            - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
        - ocaml-dune-configurator
        - ocaml-ppxlib >=0.33
        - ocaml-ocplib-endian
      run:
        - ocaml-ocplib-endian
      # the ocaml run_export does not encode the windows toolchain track
      run_constraints:
        - if: not unix
          then:
            - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/lwt/META
            - if: target_platform != "win-arm64"
              then:
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/lwt/lwt.cmxa
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/lwt/lwt${{ native_lib_ext }}
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/lwt/unix/lwt_unix.cmxa
      # script test links native executables; win-arm64 is bytecode-only
      - if: target_platform != "win-arm64"
        then:
          script: bash testing/test_lwt.sh
          files:
            recipe:
              - testing/test_lwt.sh
          requirements:
            run:
              - ocaml ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
              - if: not unix
                then:
                  - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
              - ocaml-dune >=3.20
              - if: unix
                then:
                  - ${{ compiler("c") }}
              - if: not unix and c_compiler != "gcc"
                then:
                  - ${{ compiler("c") }}
              - if: not unix
                then:
                  - m2-bash
                  - m2-coreutils
    about:
      homepage: https://github.com/ocsigen/lwt
      repository: https://github.com/ocsigen/lwt
      license: MIT
      license_file: LICENSE.md
      summary: Promises and event-driven I/O for OCaml

  - package:
      name: ocaml-${{ name }}-ppx
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      string: ${{ c_compiler ~ "_" if not unix }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      script: bash ${{ RECIPE_DIR }}/build.sh lwt_ppx
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("ocaml") }}
        - if: not unix and c_compiler == "gcc"
          then:
            - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
          else:
            - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        # no C stubs; ocamlopt still links through the C compiler on windows
        - if: not unix and c_compiler == "gcc"
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("m2w64_c") }}
        # ocaml_win-64 >=14 only run-constrains the C compiler; activate it here, once (vs2022, zig)
        - if: not unix and c_compiler != "gcc"
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        # compiler("ocaml") renders no toolchain track; name it on windows
        - if: not unix
          then:
            - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
        # the cross compiler does not pull the native one; the build runs OCaml on the build machine
        - if: build_platform != target_platform and unix
          then:
            - ocaml_${{ build_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
            # the cross compiler activates itself (shims, OCAMLLIB, host OCAMLPATH)
            - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
        # windows cross: the self-contained gcc track needs no vcvars
        - if: build_platform != target_platform and not unix
          then:
            - ocaml_${{ build_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* gcc_*
        - ocaml-dune >=3.4
        - ocaml-cppo >=1.1
        - ${{ m2 }}make
        - if: not unix
          then:
            - m2-bash
            - m2-coreutils
      host:
        # library: ocaml's run_export pins the compiler patch version
        - ocaml ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
        # the noarch ocaml metapackage does not pin the windows toolchain track
        - if: not unix
          then:
            - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
        - ocaml-ppxlib >=0.36
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('ocaml-lwt', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ocaml-ppxlib >=0.36
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('ocaml-lwt', exact=True) }}
      # the ocaml run_export does not encode the windows toolchain track
      run_constraints:
        - if: not unix
          then:
            - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/lwt_ppx/META
            - if: target_platform != "win-arm64"
              then:
                - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/lwt_ppx/lwt_ppx.cmxa
    about:
      homepage: https://github.com/ocsigen/lwt
      repository: https://github.com/ocsigen/lwt
      license: MIT
      license_file: LICENSE.md
      summary: Lwt PPX syntax extension

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/ocsigen/lwt
  repository: https://github.com/ocsigen/lwt
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.md
  summary: Promises and event-driven I/O for OCaml

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MementoRC
    - ManuelLerchner
